claims.text: Davis and Harold Puthoff had published the same argument in the open literature the previous year as 'Chapter 18: On Extracting Energy from the Quantum Vacuum' in 'Frontiers of Propulsion Science' (AIAA, 2009), the volume Davis co-edited with Marc G. Millis.

claims.nodeLabel: Concepts for Extracting Energy From the Quantum Vacuum
claims.text: EarthTech International's own publication list for Eric W. Davis independently confirms the attribution and the document number: 'Davis, E. W. (2010), "Concepts for Extracting Energy From the Quantum Vacuum," Defense Intelligence Reference Document, Acquisition Threat Support, DIA-08-1004-007, Acquisition Support Division (DWO-3), Defense Warning Office, Directorate for Analysis, Defense Intelligence Agency, Washington, DC.'

Millis is co-editor with Eric W. Davis of 'Frontiers of Propulsion Science', AIAA Progress in Astronautics & Aeronautics Vol. 227 (2009), a documented pre-DIRD collaboration with the AAWSAP subcontractor.

EarthTech International's published citation list for Eric Davis gives the same paper as "Obousy, R. K. and Davis, E. W. (2010), 'Warp Drive, Dark Energy, and the Manipulation of Extra Dimensions,' Defense Intelligence Reference Document, Acquisition Threat Support, DIA-08-1004-001, Acquisition Support Division (DWO-3), Defense Warning Office, Directorate for Analysis, Defense Intelligence Agency, Washington, DC." It is a co-authored paper with Obousy first named.

Baker co-authored a 2005 STAIF conference paper on HFGW radiation patterns and aerospace applications with Eric W. Davis and R. C. Woods, establishing a pre-existing working link to the AAWSAP subcontractor who commissioned the DIRDs.

edges.note: The cover carries DIA-08-1011-002, 1 November 2010, ICOD 8 July 2010, under the 'Defense Futures' banner. The administrative note confirms the product is one of a series produced in FY 2009 under the DIA Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program. The shift from 'Acquisition Threat Support' to 'Defense Futures' across the later 2010 deliverables marks a change in the DIA office of record, from the Acquisition Support Division (DWO-3) to the Technology Warning Division (DWO-4) of the Defense Warning Office.

edges.label: produced at EarthTech International, Austin
edges.note: EarthTech, run by Hal Puthoff, was the largest single source of DIRDs, producing six of the 38. Puthoff has stated that BAASS 'connected me at EarthTech International to collaborate as a subcontractor' and that he then let the 38 contracts himself. The arrangement means EarthTech occupied both sides of the transaction on this document: commissioning agent and author's employer.

EarthTech's own bibliography for Davis cites the same document with the matching DIA number DIA-08-1004-007, confirming the attribution against the redacted cover page independently of the DIA list.

edges.note: EarthTech International's publications page cites the paper as "Obousy, R. K. and Davis, E. W. (2010)." edges.label: author of record on the DIA list; lead author
edges.note: CORRECTION EDGE. The DIA letter of 9 January 2018, item 19, names "Dr R Obousy, Obousy Consultants" as the author of the warp-drive DIRD. Press coverage almost universally attributes this paper to Eric Davis. EarthTech's own citation gives it as Obousy, R. K. and Davis, E. W. (2010), with Obousy first named, so the two records reconcile as a co-authored paper on which DIA recorded the lead author.
